text:
Iris (People Ops): Heads-up: we have an international guest arriving at 4pm (Anika from Lumen). Her passport was needed for customs on a courier note; courier left a customs slip at desk and package is marked 'hold for ID'. Can someone meet and help check ID?
Front Desk (Bot): Delivery logged: 1x padded envelope for Anika (Lumen). Status: hold for ID. Badge preprint ready.
Sam: I can meet in lobby at 3:55 and handle the ID check. Anyone with a travel adapter we can lend?
Vik: I have a USB-C EU->US adapter in my drawer, can bring it.
Marcus: I can escort and reserve Huddle B 4:00-4:30. Also will put "Anika (Lumen)" on the board.
Iris (People Ops): Thanks — please note parking instruction: visitor code is V17C at kiosk (2 hrs). Also note: if courier needs signature, Front Desk will sign on behalf if guest isn't present.
Front Desk (Bot): Courier contacted: will hold until 4:10. Package moved to holding locker #2.
Sam: At lobby now. Courier asked if guest wants to sign in digitally; forwarded QR.
Vik: Adapter grabbed and heading down.
Marcus: Huddle B reserved. Escorting now.
Iris (People Ops): FYI badge color: visitor-red. Grant network access label sent to IT for temporary guest wifi.
Sam: ID check complete, courier released the package. Guest escorted up. All good.
Iris (People Ops): Thanks team! Please add any expenses to the People Ops expense sheet if courier had customs fees. :memo:
